newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy buys oil and gas operation.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy buys oil and gas operation.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the oil and gas operations of subsidiaries of MidAmerican Energy Co for cash, short-term notes and 610,000 warrants on KCS common stock.
KCS said it has agreed to pay $174 million in cash and a $40 million short-term note in addition to the warrants for InterCoast Oil and Gas Co.
The warrants have a four-year term and an exercise price of $45 per share.

The principal assets involved in the transaction are proved reserves of 220 billion cubic feet equivalent, of which about 80 percent are natural gas and 80 percent are proved developed, from 2,051 gross wells.
The transaction is expected to close before the end of the year.
The reserves are principally in Texas, Louisiana and Oklahoma. InterCoast is formerly known as Medallion Production Co.
